instruction: In this Python repository, bucket() does not honour a falsey validator: when the validator callable is falsey (e.g. an empty set subclass used as a membership check), bucket() replaces it with the default validator instead of using it. The failing test is tests/test_more.py::BucketTests::test_falsey_validator_is_honoured - it is already applied to the working tree. Find the bucket() implementation in more_itertools/more.py, fix it so a falsey validator is honoured, and verify with run_tests.
